parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The accelerated domain name to query. You can query multiple domain names in a single request. To do so, separate the domain names with commas (,). You can specify up to 30 domain names.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. The time is in UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time. The time range cannot exceed 1 hour.

parameters.name: Field
parameters.description: The metrics to query. You can query multiple metrics at a time. Separate multiple metrics with commas (,). Valid values: **bps**, **qps**, **traf**, **acc**, **ipv6\_traf**, **ipv6\_bps**, **ipv6\_acc**, **ipv6\_qps**, and **http\_code**.

parameters.name: IspNameEn
parameters.description:
The name of the carrier. You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation to query carrier names.

If you do not set this parameter, data for all carriers is returned.

parameters.name: Layer
parameters.description:
The dimension to query. Valid values are **http**, **https**, and **quic** for the application layer, or **all**.

The default value is **all**.

parameters.name: LocationNameEn
parameters.description:
The name of the region. You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation to query region names.

If you do not set this parameter, data for all regions is returned.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. The time is in UTC.
